tool_input.command:
git add DESIGN.md internal/hook/pretooluse_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs+test: fix asymmetric prose (K9), name the worse hand-edit (K10), harden two tests (K11)

Review findings K9, K10, K11 (full-branch review, m-2026-09-08-004
round 3), all MEDIUM:

K9: residual-risk item 2's out-of-order-spawning prose described only
HALF the misattribution -- m-B's spawn goes to m-A, but m-A's own later
spawn then matches the only entry left, m-B. Two misattributions from
one out-of-order pair, a full swap -- the same doubling C1 already
names explicitly for its own sequence. Corrected to say so.

K10: the security review enumerated hand-editing a delegation's
`bound_via` as a known, accepted trust-boundary gap, but not the
sibling gap of hand-editing `verdict: aborted` -- which is strictly
worse, since it unlocks the same gate with NO audit trail at all (no
disclaimed_at, no disclaim_delegation event), unlike disclaim's
permanent, attributable record. Named as its own bullet.

K11(a): TestDispatchAgent_ActiveMissionSidecarClaimOrigin_StaysAfterConsume
asserted only that the mission ID survives (ReadActiveMission), the one
field that reads the same whether the binding is a claim or a stale
dispatch shape. The dispatch-side mirror (round 1's F6) asserts Origin
explicitly; the claim side was never made symmetric. Added the same
Origin assertion via ReadActiveMissionBinding.

K11(b): DESIGN.md called TestStore_Abandon_SucceedsAfterDepthRefusalWithNoDisclaim
(package mission) "the end-to-end proof using the real depth-refusal
shape," but that test's own comment says "simulate" -- it hand-calls
CloseDelegationSkeleton rather than driving enforceDelegationDepth
through HandlePreToolUse, and package mission cannot import package
hook to do so. Added
TestHandlePreToolUse_DepthRefusalThenAbandonNeedsNoDisclaim in package
hook: drives a real Tier B spawn through the depth gate with the
ceiling exceeded, confirms the hook itself denies it and closes the
skeleton aborted, then confirms Abandon succeeds with no disclaim.
Confirmed failing against a targeted revert of the aborted exclusion in
countBlockingDelegations (reverted after confirming, then restored).
Corrected DESIGN.md's overstated claim about the mission-package test.
EOF
)"
